title: Borrower's Share of the Rate Lock Commitment Relock Fee After Appraisal Delays
content:
After an appraisal delay, the borrower may pay only part of a **Rate Lock Commitment** relock fee. The borrower pays a share of the relock fee points. The share applies to the relock fee points after every addition to and subtraction from them, which never take them below zero. The shared figure is rounded to three decimal places.

The basis is the lock's pricing ledger and the file's **Appraisal Order**:

- the waiver entries on the lock;
- the borrower-borne extension entries on the lock;
- whether the appraisal report was completed after its due date.

**Rule.**

- When the lock's waiver entries are at least as many as its borrower-borne extension entries, and the file's appraisal report was completed after its due date, the borrower pays the full-relief share of **0.25** of the fee.
- When the lock carries at least one waiver entry, or the appraisal report was completed after its due date, the borrower pays the part-relief share of **0.5**.
- Otherwise the borrower pays the whole fee.

| Waiver entries compared with borrower-borne extension entries | Appraisal report completed after its due date | Share the borrower pays |
|---|---|---|
| At least as many | Yes | 0.25 |
| Fewer, but at least one | Yes | 0.5 |
| At least one | No | 0.5 |
| None | Yes, with borrower-borne extension entries on the lock | 0.5 |
| None | No | 1 (the whole fee) |

*Hypothetical case:* relock fee points of 0.375, after every addition and subtraction, on a lock with 2 borrower-borne extensions and 2 waiver entries after a late appraisal. The borrower pays 0.25 of 0.375, which is 0.09375, rounded to 0.094 points.
